text: Yuki's knee operation is booked for next Tuesday. She's been told to expect two nights in hospital and crutches for a month afterwards. She's worried about the stairs in her flat and about being off work, since her manager wasn't thrilled. I should offer to do a food shop for her the weekend after, and remind her that her mum Mrs Tanaka offered to stay too.

Jorge invited me to his housewarming on Saturday. New flat is in Leith, near the shore. I'm bringing a lemon tart. He said his girlfriend Lila will be there, and a few people from his old climbing club, including Rory and Andre. Starts around 6, but he said nobody will turn up before 8. Last time he hosted, the neighbours complained, so it's meant to wind down by midnight.
Remind me to text Tanvi the morning of her scan on Thursday. She's really nervous about it.

Oscar's dad had a fall at the weekend and broke his wrist. He's staying with Oscar and his wife Camila until he can manage on his own. The surgeon said six weeks in a cast, then physio. Camila is doing most of the driving to appointments and is pretty worn out, with the kids off school next week too. I need to ask Oscar on Friday if they want me to have the kids for an afternoon.
Nikhil mentioned he's coeliac, so if I host the dinner I need to sort a gluten-free dessert.
Shanice said the birthday drinks on Friday are off because her sister is in hospital. Should check in with her over the weekend.
Dentist moved to Wednesday at 9. Pick up the dry cleaning on the way back.
Lachlan is home from hospital after his appendix came out. He sounded tired but cheerful. Pop round with soup a couple of days after he's settled.
Rohan and Divya are hosting a dinner for their tenth anniversary next Saturday. Dress code smart casual, apparently.
Sunil's little girl has chickenpox, so he's working from home all week. Poor thing kept him up until three last night.
Mohammed Khan, Mo to everyone at work, goes in for his hernia repair tomorrow. Don't forget to message him the day after to see how it went.
Ioana's mum is having a hip replacement in a fortnight. Ioana is flying to Bucharest the day before to be with her and staying a week after.
Lovely evening at Juan's. He's mad about sourdough at the moment and made three different loaves. His dog Pepa stole half of one off the table.
Bruno has been off work with a bad back since last Monday. Physio on Thursday, and he's hoping to be back the following week.
Must get a card for Dalia. Her grandad passed away on Sunday and the funeral is next Friday.
Katarzyna's surgery went well yesterday. Gall bladder out, home by the evening. I should send flowers once she's back on her feet.
Kalani's party is this Saturday, starting at 7. It's a surprise for her husband Wiremu's fortieth, so keep quiet. She hinted he'd love anything to do with fly fishing.

Hoang said his son broke his arm at football. Cast for six weeks, and he's gutted because it means missing the school tournament. Hoang's wife Rana thinks the boy needs something to look forward to, so they're taking him to watch a match the Saturday after the cast comes off. He's obsessed with goalkeeping and wants proper gloves for Christmas.
Rana is struggling a bit since the miscarriage. She doesn't want to talk about it yet but appreciated the message. Check in with her again next week, gently.
Tendai's follow-up appointment with the cardiologist is on the 14th. Results from the echo should be back by then.
Need to RSVP to Neha's engagement dinner by Wednesday.
Rory sprained his ankle at five-a-side on Tuesday. On crutches for now, which he finds hilarious.
Carlos and Lila are having a joint birthday barbecue next Sunday afternoon. Lila's vegetarian, Carlos eats anything.

Idris was in A&E all night with his daughter, who had a really high fever. She's on antibiotics now and seems better this morning. Idris looked shattered at the school gate. The doctor wants to see her again on Wednesday if the temperature comes back, and his wife Farah is staying home with her tomorrow. Message him tomorrow evening to see how she's doing.
Farah is anxious about her MRI on Monday. She hates enclosed spaces. Text her good luck that morning and ring her in the evening.
Arjun's mum has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. He's reading everything he can about it and trying to change the whole family's diet.
Andre is hosting a games night on Friday. Bring snacks and the Catan expansion.
Booked my flu jab for next Thursday at the pharmacy.
Camila mentioned she's training for a half marathon in the spring. Really into trail running now too.

Yuki rang. The knee surgery went fine and she's already doing the exercises. Physio says she can drive again in about three weeks. Her partner Oscar has taken the week off to look after her, which is sweet.
Jorge's housewarming was great. Met his sister Neha, who's a paediatric nurse at the Royal. Remind me to send him the recipe for the tart.
Tanvi's scan was all clear! So relieved for her. Send congrats tomorrow, and maybe take her out for lunch the week after.
Dr Popescu wants to see Sunil's son again in a month to review the asthma inhaler.

Shanice's sister had her operation this morning. Everything went smoothly according to Shanice, but she'll be in for at least four days. Their mum is driving down from Leeds tomorrow to help with the kids.
Don't forget Lachlan's birthday dinner next Wednesday. He wants to try that new Korean place.
Nikhil's partner Rohan is waiting on a date for his shoulder surgery. Could be as soon as next month. Nikhil says Rohan is pretending he's not bothered but is clearly stressed.
Bruno's back is much better. He's back at the gym and says he's never skipping stretching again.

Long chat with Ioana on the phone. Her mum's hip operation is still on for the 3rd, but the hospital moved it from the morning to the afternoon. Ioana is flying out on the Sunday before, and her brother Nikhil is covering the second week so she can come home. She's worried about her mum managing stairs afterwards. I should call her the evening of the operation and then again a few days later.
Juan's leaving do is on Thursday at the Crown. He's off to a new job in Manchester.
Kalani told me Wiremu's surprise party is cancelled. He found out, so they're doing a quiet dinner instead.
Mo's hernia op went fine. Back at work in two weeks, and his wife has banned him from lifting anything heavier than a kettle.
Remind me to ring Uncle Hoang on Friday. His cataract surgery is the day before and he won't be able to read texts for a bit.
Groceries for the weekend: eggs, spinach, oat milk, the good coffee.
Rana's dad is in hospital with pneumonia. He went in on Tuesday and they're keeping him in until at least next week.
Tendai has a new puppy called Biscuit. He sent me about forty photos.
Dalia said the funeral went as well as it could. Lots of family came over from Cairo. She's taking the rest of the week off.

Neha's engagement dinner is next Saturday at 7.30 at her parents' place. Her fiancé Arjun is cooking, which she says is brave. It's a small one, just family and a few friends, so I'm honoured to be invited. Her grandmother is coming over from Delhi for it, and Neha is nervous about the two families meeting properly for the first time. Bring a bottle of something nice and maybe flowers for her mum.

Rory says his ankle is mostly healed but he's lost interest in five-a-side for now. Getting into climbing instead. He's joined the bouldering wall near the station and goes Tuesday and Thursday evenings. He keeps asking me to come along, so I said I'd try it the week after next once my shoulder is better. He's also got his brother Arjun hooked, apparently.
Divya had a migraine all weekend and missed Lachlan's barbecue. She gets them whenever she's run down.
Lila's mum is going in for a lumpectomy on Wednesday. Lila is taking her and staying overnight. I should drop off a meal on Thursday so she doesn't have to cook when she gets back.
Need to book an appointment with the GP about my shoulder. Ring at 8 tomorrow.
Idris and Farah are throwing a christening party for their baby in a fortnight. The church bit is at 11, then lunch at theirs afterwards. I said I'd bring a salad.
Carlos has been really low since his op. Long recovery, can't work, and he's bored out of his mind. Invite him for coffee this weekend.
Andre's cat Miso had surgery on her paw yesterday. Andre is fussing over her like a newborn.
Katarzyna Wright, Kasia, from the book club, is hosting the Christmas dinner this year. She's already planning the menu and says she loves anything with cardamom.
Oscar's mum is home after her stroke. She's in rehab three days a week, and Oscar visits on Tuesdays and Saturdays. He seems exhausted.
Tanvi's son starts at the new nursery on Monday after weeks off sick with tonsillitis. She's hoping he finally stays well.
Ioana texted that her mum is home already. Walking with a frame and very stubborn about it. I must ask her next week how the first few days at home went.
Quiet one tonight. Early night, then gym first thing tomorrow before work.

Saw Jorge and Camila at the hospital café yesterday. Jorge was there for a blood test and Camila for her post-op check on her wrist. Both fine, both moaning about the parking. Camila's back at work next Monday, and Jorge wants us all to go for dinner the weekend after to celebrate her cast coming off. Remind me to book somewhere for that Saturday.
